title: Homo Fluxus: A Thermodynamic Framework for Consciousness, Systemic Empathy, and Aligned Intelligence
abstract: Proposes a thermodynamic substrate for cognition in which local entropy minimization via coherent information flow underlies consciousness, affect, ethics, and AI alignment. Introduces Homo Fluxus (agent-as-node-in-flow) and systemic empathy (field-coupled coherence sensitivity), and specifies operational proxies for a coherence potential with falsifiable, cross-scale predictions.
